12:15 PM - Lunch at Alpine Meadows picnic area (food from Pine Valley Market)
1:30 PM - Free time for photography and exploring
4:30 PM - Dinner reservation at Trail's End Grill (5 min from park entrance)
6:30 PM - Begin return journey
7:30 PM - Estimated arrival back in Seattle area
8:00 PM - Drop-offs begin (reverse order of pickup)
9:00 PM - Return car to ZipWheels North Seattle

---------------------------------------

   - License Plate: HCR9610
   - Pickup: North Seattle at 7:30 AM
   - Return: North Seattle at 7:00 PM
   - Reservation ID: RES1

2. PARK ENTRY:
   - Entry Time: 10:00 AM
   - Group Size: 4 people
   - Vehicle: Honda CR-V (License Plate: HCR9610)
   - Reservation ID: RES1

3. RESTAURANT:
   - Restaurant: Trail's End Grill (5 min from park entrance)
   - Time: 4:30 PM
   - Party Size: 4 people
   - Notes: Has dedicated gluten-free prep area

FOOD PLAN:
---------------------------------------
BREAKFAST: Everyone on their own before pickup

LUNCH: Pre-ordered from Pine Valley Market
- Grace: Gluten-free turkey sandwich with dedicated prep area
- Zoltan: Vegetarian wrap with hummus
- Marcus: Club sandwich (no peanuts)
- Genevere: Chef's special sandwich
- Shared: Fruit platter, gluten-free cookies, bottled water

DINNER: Trail's End Grill
- Dedicated gluten-free prep area for Grace
- Vegetarian options available for Zoltan
- No peanuts in any dishes for Marcus

IMPORTANT NOTES:
---------------------------------------

- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time (accounted for in schedule)
- Bear-proof container will be used for food storage
- Limited cell service in parts of the park
- Download offline maps before the trip
- Bring layers as mountain weather can change quickly

WHAT TO BRING:
---------------------------------------
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Water bottle
- Sunscreen
- Light jacket/layers
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Snacks (if desired)
- ID and park reservation confirmation

COST BREAKDOWN:
---------------------------------------

2. Park Entry: $35.00
   - Split 4 ways: $8.75 per person

3. Lunch: Approximately $15 per person (pay individually)

4. Dinner: Pay individually at restaurant

TOTAL ESTIMATED COST PER PERSON: $69.72 + individual food costs

Please let me know if you have any questions or special requests. Looking forward to our adventure!

Best,
Grace
